objective: Correct and verify all converted datasets, not only a selected task/signal subset
completion_requirements: Resolve each observed defect in conversion code and regenerated artifacts
Cover all source tasks, subjects, conditions and available signals; account for exclusions and unsupported sources
Preserve measured timing, anatomical identities, mass, units and signs without invented values
Check source-to-output correspondence across affected tasks and both sides
Verify full structural integrity and stable identities with bounded reads
Bind file versions, previews, reports and any filtered variants to source/output hashes and exclusion ledgers
Keep missing evidence and unverified scientific assumptions open; fixture passes alone are not completion
